basic_details.job_title: BHEL Rajbhasha Anuvadak Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), Boiler Auxiliaries Plant (BAP), Ranipet has invited applications for 2 unreserved FTA Grade III Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator) posts on a fixed tenure basis of 2 years or completion of assignments, whichever is earlier. The all-inclusive consolidated pay is Rs.45000/- a month in the 1st year and Rs 48,000/- in the 2nd year. Applicants need a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Hindi and English as printed below and 2 years' post-qualification translation experience. Online applications run from 16 November 2026 to 7 December 2026 at careers.bhel.in,

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice lists these relaxations: | Category Relaxation Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) 10 years for Unreserved Ex-Servicemen Reservation and relaxation as per extant Govt. Rules Candidates ordinarily domiciled in the state of Jammu & Kashmir from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989 5 years

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification FTA Grade III Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator) Any one of the four options listed below | Master's degree in Hindi from a recognised University with English as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in English from a recognised University with Hindi as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in Hindi and English from a recognised University; OR Bachelor's degree from a recognised University with Hindi and English as main subjects.

physical_eligibility.details: The notice describes BHEL as India's premier engineering organisation, supplying products and services to sectors such as power generation and transmission, industry, transportation, oil and gas, renewable energy and defence. It states that BHEL has 15 manufacturing divisions, 4 Power Sector Regional Centres, 8 Service Centres, 15 Regional Offices and 4 Overseas Offices. This recruitment is issued by BHEL, BAP Ranipet, Tamilnadu (phone 04172 – 284325/284626).

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the BHEL careers website, https://careers.bhel.in. The notice states that online submission is the only way to submit applications.

Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 236/- through SB Collect (https://sbcollect.sbi.bank.in/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm), unless exempted. Enter: Category Govt/PSU/Courts; Name BHEL BAP RANIPET; Payment Category Others; Amount 236; Remarks FTA Processing Fees.
Note the SB Collect Reference No and enter it in the fee remittance details of the online application.
Download the filled-in application form from https://careers.bhel.in, sign it and paste a photograph.
Enclose the self-certified documents and, where the fee was paid, the printout of the SB Collect e-receipt.
Write "Application for the Post of FTA Grade III Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator)" on the envelope.

Send it by Post/Courier to: Sr. Manager (HRM), Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, Boiler Auxiliaries Plant, Ranipet, Tamilnadu – 632406, so that it reaches on or before 14 December 2026, or by 21 December 2026 from far flung areas.

The far flung areas are Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Jammu & Kashmir, Lahaul & Spiti District and Pangi SubDivision of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, or abroad. BHEL will not be responsible for any postal loss or delay.

Exempted candidates must still send the application form to the address above. PwBD, J&K domiciled candidates and Ex-Servicemen must state their category carefully in the online form, as it cannot be changed later.
Self-certified copies are to be submitted with the application; originals are required for verification at the interview.
Date of birth proof: Class 10th Mark Sheet / Certificate
Category Certificate, valid PwBD certificate and Discharge certificate for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable
Final consolidated, semester-wise or year-wise mark sheet; where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or letter grade is awarded, proof of the University's norms for conversion into percentage
Certificate for Graduation / Post Graduation with mark list
Certificate for age relaxation, if claimed as a candidate from J&K
For PwBD candidates, a duly stamped medical certificate from a Govt. Hospital or Medical Board attached to a Special Employment Exchange
Work experience proof: joining and relieving letter, OR experience/service certificate showing date of joining and relieving for each organisation, OR salary certificate with ITR or Form-16
important_instructions: Candidates attending the interview will not be paid any TA / DA. Candidates who fail to submit original documents at the interview will not be allowed to attend it. Candidates employed in Govt./Semi Govt/PSU/Autonomous Body must apply through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview. If they face difficulty, they may apply directly and produce the relieving order from their organisation if selected. Candidates working as FTA in any BHEL Unit/Division/Region must submit a No Objection Certificate from the respective BHEL Office along with the application. Appointment is subject to medical examination by the Company's Doctor/Authorised Medical Practitioners/PTMO as per BHEL Medical Attendance Rules. Incomplete applications, or applications in a format other than the one prescribed on the BHEL website, will not be entertained. False or incorrect information, or failure to meet the eligibility criteria, makes candidature or service liable to rejection or termination without notice. Candidates should keep their e-mail ID active for at least one year, as BHEL will send important intimations by e-mail. BHEL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge or reopen the recruitment process. Any corrigendum or extension will be published only on https://careers.bhel.in. Queries may be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About BHEL BAP Ranipet
content_sections.text: The notice describes BHEL as India's premier engineering organisation, supplying products and services to sectors such as power generation and transmission, industry, transportation, oil and gas, renewable energy and defence. It states that BHEL has 15 manufacturing divisions, 4 Power Sector Regional Centres, 8 Service Centres, 15 Regional Offices and 4 Overseas Offices. This recruitment is issued by BHEL, BAP Ranipet, Tamilnadu (phone 04172 – 284325/284626).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice requires the job specifications to be held as on 01.11.2026. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Master's degree in Hindi from a recognised University with English as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in English from a recognised University with Hindi as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in Hindi and English from a recognised University; OR Bachelor's degree from a recognised University with Hindi and English as main subjects. A minimum of 2 years' post-qualification experience of translation work from English to Hindi and vice versa is required. The notice says this experience should exclude any Trainee/Apprenticeship period, and candidates without the relevant 2 years' experience need not apply. The upper age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice lists these relaxations: Both posts are shown as Unreserved. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC applying for posts where no reservation is indicated are treated as "Unreserved" without any relaxed standards. The Hindi Translator position is identified for OH: Locomotor disability (OL & BL), Leprosy cured, Dwarfism, Cerebral Palsy and Acid Attack Victim, and PwBD reservation will follow Government directives. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: In addition, the notice provides reimbursement of the premium for a Mediclaim Policy up to Rs. 5 lakhs, to be taken by the FTA for self, spouse and eligible dependent children. No other medical benefits are admissible. The post is purely temporary, is not against any permanent vacancy and does not entitle the candidate to regular or permanent employment in BHEL in future.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be invited for a Personal Interview. If eligible applications exceed the prescribed ratio of 1:10, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:10 based on marks obtained in the prescribed qualifications. For aggregate marks, all subjects in the mark sheets of all semesters are considered; on a 10-point scale, equivalent marks follow the University's calculation or the GPA multiplied by 10. Candidates obtaining the same cut-off marks in the respective category are also called for interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Recruitment 2026 for Hindi Translator?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for FTA Grade III Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator), both shown as Unreserved.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 7 December 2026. The signed hard copy must reach BAP Ranipet by 14 December 2026, or by 21 December 2026 from far flung areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BHEL Rajbhasha Anuvadak?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Hindi with English at graduation level, a Master's degree in English with Hindi at graduation level, a Master's degree in Hindi and English, or a Bachelor's degree with Hindi and English as main subjects, plus 2 years' post-qualification translation experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026. PwBD Unreserved candidates get 10 years' relaxation, and J&K domiciles of 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989 get 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the BHEL FTA Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: The all-inclusive consolidated pay is Rs.45000/- per month in the 1st year and Rs 48,000/- in the 2nd year. Mediclaim premium reimbursement up to Rs. 5 lakhs is also provided.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 236/-, non-refundable, paid online through SB Collect. SC/ST, Ex-Servicemen and PwBD candidates are exempted from the processing fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online at careers.bhel.in, then send the signed application form with self-certified documents by Post/Courier to Sr. Manager (HRM), Boiler Auxiliaries Plant, Ranipet, Tamilnadu – 632406.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are invited for a Personal Interview. If eligible applications exceed the 1:10 ratio, shortlisting is based on marks obtained in the prescribed qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, on fixed tenure for a maximum of 2 years or completion of assignments, whichever is earlier, and gives no entitlement to regular employment in BHEL.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that candidates attending the interview will not be paid any TA / DA.
